# mRNA dependencies

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README_zh.md)

The source registry exposes core backends, optional backends, built-in operations,
and unavailable research routes. Each is represented in
[dependencies.json](dependencies.json) with the acquisition stage and file paths
actually consumed by the adapters. No upstream source, weights, datasets, or
historical readiness records are bundled.

```bash
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh --help
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh plan gemorna
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh check optional
# Explicit operations; these can install packages and download assets:
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh install peptide-runtime
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh install runtime
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh install qwen
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh install core
bash third_party/mrna/install.sh install optional
```

`core` is an explicit grouped stage for GEMORNA, LinearDesign, RiboNN, Smart5UTR,
Optimus5, PARADE and reference records. It creates the Python 3.10 compatibility
environment, fetches pinned source, builds LinearDesign and fetches the declared
weights. Selecting one of these model IDs for installation resolves to the whole
core stage; `plan MODEL` shows that scope before installation.

`optional` is a grouped stage for codonGPT, UTRGAN, mRNAutilus, Saluki,
RNAdegformer, UTR-LM, mRNABERT and DegScore. It also fetches the pinned source
support libraries and creates the Transformers 4 compatibility environment.
Individual optional IDs resolve to this complete stage. The installer does not
create inference-readiness records: optional models remain missing from a
readiness check until the required local evidence exists. Downloads alone do not
activate them.

`references` fetches only the public NCBI/UniProt reference records.
`esmfold2-preview` delegates asset acquisition to the Enzyme installer (install
its runtime first). `synonymous`, `vienna` and `joint` map to runtime packages;
`joint` still requires caller-provided proposals with provenance. `promorna` and
`mrna_gpt` have no executable integrated acquisition path and return missing,
with their upstream research links and required follow-up listed in the manifest.

Default layout (`MRNA_DATA_DIR`, default `~/.cache/decoupled-rsi/mrna`):

```text
<MRNA_DATA_DIR>/
  venv/bin/python                       # modern scientific runtime
  envs/gemorna/bin/python                # Python 3.10 compatibility runtime
  envs/transformers4/bin/python          # Transformers 4 compatibility runtime
  external/
    GEMORNA/{src/shared/*.so, vocab/*.pkl, checkpoints/*.pt}
    LinearDesign/{bin/LinearDesign_2D, codon_usage_freq_table_human.csv}
    RiboNN/src/
    Smart5UTR/models/{Smart5UTR, Optimus5-Prime}/*.h5
    parade/predictor/{model, regression_multiple/saved_models}
    basenji/   UTRGAN/   UTR-LM/   DegScore/   arnie/
    RNAdegformer-Webapp/{RNA_Inference/best_weights, MultiRNAFold}
  models/
    qwen/<revision>/                     # fallback when shared Qwen is absent
    ribonn/{human,mouse}/{runs.csv,<run>/state_dict.pth}
    codongpt/   mrnabert/   mrnautilus/
    saluki/f*_c*/train/{params.json,model0_best.h5,model1_best.h5}
  datasets/{references.json, NM_000518.5.gb, P42212.fasta, P08659.fasta}
  assets.json                           # hashes/revisions generated by fetchers
  model-validation.json                 # required local evidence; not bundled
```

`PEPTIDE_PYTHON` selects the base runtime. `MRNA_PYTHON` selects the runtime for
these installation wrappers; the application's normal interpreter remains the
one with which it is launched. Shared Qwen follows `MRNA_QWEN_DIR`, then
`PEPTIDE_MODEL_DIR` / the sibling peptide model directory, then the local fallback.
Protein previews use `MRNA_ESMFOLD_DIR` or the Enzyme model directory.

All sources and model terms remain upstream-specific, including research-only
and noncommercial terms recorded by the source registry. Review the linked terms
before acquisition/use. The installer cannot grant access to licensed resources.

`plan` / `check` are offline standard-library operations. They never import models
or create output directories. Check results are `missing` (exit 2) or
`present_unvalidated` (exit 0), not a claim that inference or biological validation
passed. An install can return 2 after successfully downloading assets when
required readiness evidence is still missing. No implicit `install all` exists.
